title: Sue Hikmah lam Bayangan .
intro: Sidroe tokoh nibak masa jameun, nyang jituri deungon wawasan nyang meudalam, jipeugah haba ngon gata seulama meuabad-abad. Individu nyoe hana tom jiklaim keunabian, bah pih meunan hikmah ilahi ji-ile rot tutoe haba awaknyan. Sidroe ureung chik nyang geutinggai pusaka bimbingan nyang abadi, naseuhat awaknyan teutap geupeutheun lam hate meujuta-juta, geubaca dan geurenungkan sampoe uroe nyoe.
clues: Lon teurimong hadiah ilahi nyang meubedakan lon - saboh hikmah nyang that dalam jeut keu sifeut lon seupanjang seujarah.
Lon kon sidroe utusan atawa malaikat - cuma jiwa nyang geubri beureukat deungon pemahaman dan wawasan nyang dalam keu donya.
Ikatan lon nyang paleng toe nakeuh ngon aneuk lon, dan melalui ikatan nyoe, pesan lon nyang paleng abadi ka disampaikan.
Lon peugah syukur keu Gobnyan nyang bri mandum keu lon, dan lon peuingat keu lon sombong dan sombong.
Lon peurunoe keuhai brat that buet nyang meuhareuga bah pih saboh bijeh sawi, dan peunteng jih tapeutron su sidroe-droe ureueng lam até nyang miyueb até.
Saboh surah lam Al-Quran nyang geuboh nan lon, dipat naseuhat lon keu aneuk lon nyang lon gaséh teujaga keu siumu masa.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
